Questions & answers

Who is eligible for this offer?

This offer is available to owners of qualifying Samsung Galaxy devices (Samsung Galaxy Tab S10 Lite, Tab S11). Eligibility is automatically verified when you download Notion from the Galaxy Store on an eligible device. See full offer terms.

What does this offer include?

This offer includes 1 month of Notion Business plan for free, with unlimited access to exclusive templates. Learn more about Notion Business.

How do I activate my offer?

Simply download Notion from the Galaxy Store on an eligible Samsung device - Samsung Galaxy Tab S10 Lite or Tab S11. Once you install Notion and log in, the offer will be automatically applied when you create a new workspace.

Is this offer available worldwide?

This offer is available to Samsung users globally, with Notion features optimized for your region.

What if I already have a Notion account?

Notion users with eligible Samsung devices can also take advantage of this offer. To do so, make sure to install Notion from the Galaxy Store. Once you install Notion and log in, the offer will be automatically applied to the first new workspace that you create. For more details, see full offer terms.
